signature: SUBROUTINE ZTGSEN( IJOB, WANTQ, WANTZ, SELECT, N, A, LDA, B, LDB,

params.name: ijob
params.reference:
Specifies whether condition numbers are required for the cluster of eigenvalues (`PL` and `PR`) or the deflating subspaces (Difu and Difl):

-   `=0`: Only reorder w.r.t. `SELECT`. No extras.
-   `=1`: Reciprocal of norms of "projections" onto left and right eigenspaces w.r.t. the selected cluster (`PL` and `PR`).
-   `=2`: Upper bounds on Difu and Difl. F-norm-based estimate (`DIF(1:2)`).
-   `=3`: Estimate of Difu and Difl. 1-norm-based estimate (`DIF(1:2)`). About 5 times as expensive as `IJOB = 2`.
-   `=4`: Compute `PL`, `PR` and `DIF` (i.e. 0, 1 and 2 above): Economic version to get it all.
-   `=5`: Compute `PL`, `PR` and `DIF` (i.e. 0, 1 and 3 above)

params.name: wantq
params.reference: .TRUE. : update the left transformation matrix Q; .FALSE.: do not update Q.

params.name: wantz
params.reference: .TRUE. : update the right transformation matrix Z; .FALSE.: do not update Z.

params.name: SELECT
params.reference: `SELECT` specifies the eigenvalues in the selected cluster. To select an eigenvalue w(j), `SELECT(j)` must be set to .TRUE..

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrices A and B. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the upper triangular matrix A, in generalized Schur canonical form. On exit, A is overwritten by the reordered matrix A.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the upper triangular matrix B, in generalized Schur canonical form. On exit, B is overwritten by the reordered matrix B.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: BETA
params.reference: The diagonal elements of A and B, respectively, when the pair (A,B) has been reduced to generalized Schur form. `ALPHA(i)`/`BETA(i)` $i=1$,...,N are the generalized eigenvalues.

params.name: Q
params.reference: On entry, if `WANTQ` = .TRUE., Q is an N-by-N matrix. On exit, Q has been postmultiplied by the left unitary transformation matrix which reorder (A, B); The leading M columns of Q form orthonormal bases for the specified pair of left eigenspaces (deflating subspaces). If `WANTQ` = .FALSE., Q is not referenced.

params.name: ldq
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Q. $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge 1$. If `WANTQ` = .TRUE., $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge N$.

params.name: Z
params.reference: On entry, if `WANTZ` = .TRUE., Z is an N-by-N matrix. On exit, Z has been postmultiplied by the left unitary transformation matrix which reorder (A, B); The leading M columns of Z form orthonormal bases for the specified pair of left eigenspaces (deflating subspaces). If `WANTZ` = .FALSE., Z is not referenced.

params.name: ldz
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Z. $\mathrm{LDZ} \ge 1$. If `WANTZ` = .TRUE., $\mathrm{LDZ} \ge N$.

params.name: m
params.reference: The dimension of the specified pair of left and right eigenspaces, (deflating subspaces) $0 \le M \le N$.

params.name: pr
params.reference: If `IJOB = 1`, 4 or 5, `PL`, `PR` are lower bounds on the reciprocal of the norm of "projections" onto left and right eigenspace with respect to the selected cluster. $0 < \mathrm{PL}$, $\mathrm{PR} \le 1$. If $M = 0$ or $M = N$, `PL = PR = 1`. If `IJOB = 0`, 2 or 3 `PL`, `PR` are not referenced.

params.name: DIF
params.reference: If $\mathrm{IJOB} \ge 2$, `DIF(1:2)` store the estimates of Difu and Difl. If `IJOB = 2` or 4, `DIF(1:2)` are F-norm-based upper bounds on Difu and Difl. If `IJOB = 3` or 5, `DIF(1:2)` are 1-norm-based estimates of Difu and Difl, computed using reversed communication with ZLACN2. If $M = 0$ or N, $\mathrm{DIF}(1:2) = F-\operatorname{norm}([A, B])$. If `IJOB = 0` or 1, `DIF` is not referenced.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `WORK(1)` returns the optimal `LWORK`.

params.name: lwork
params.reference:
The dimension of the array `WORK`. $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge 1$ If `IJOB = 1`, 2 or 4, $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge 2 \, M \, (N-M)$ If `IJOB = 3` or 5, $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge 4 \, M \, (N-M)$

If `LWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed; the routine only calculates the optimal size of the `WORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `WORK` array, and no error message related to `LWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: IWORK
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `IWORK(1)` returns the optimal `LIWORK`.

params.name: liwork
params.reference:
The dimension of the array `IWORK`. $\mathrm{LIWORK} \ge 1$. If `IJOB = 1`, 2 or 4, $\mathrm{LIWORK} \ge N+2$; If `IJOB = 3` or 5, $\mathrm{LIWORK} \ge \max (N+2, 2 \, M \, (N-M))$;

If `LIWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed; the routine only calculates the optimal size of the `IWORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `IWORK` array, and no error message related to `LIWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `=0`: Successful exit.
-   `<0`: If `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
-   `=1`: Reordering of (A, B) failed because the transformed matrix pair (A, B) would be too far from generalized Schur form; the problem is very ill-conditioned. (A, B) may have been partially reordered. If requested, 0 is returned in `DIF(*)`, `PL` and `PR`.
